Velldot modules

Choose the capabilities your team needs.

Each module has its own purpose and can be enabled for the organization’s workspace through Velldot Cloud.

Projects

Plan delivery, milestones, teams, approvals, time and project costs.

Finance

Manage accounts, journals, ledgers, invoices and financial reporting.

Procurement

Manage suppliers, quotations, purchase orders, receiving and bills.

Human Resources

Maintain employee records, recruitment, leave, attendance, payroll and performance.

Inventory

Track products, stock movements, transfers, adjustments and valuation.

Sales & CRM

Manage customer relationships, sales opportunities, quotations and pipeline activity.

Helpdesk & SLA

Track service requests, assignments, response targets and support contracts.

Asset Management

Track asset custody, lifecycle, maintenance and endpoint discovery.

Point of Sale

Run tills, cashier shifts, checkout, refunds and payment reconciliation.

Signatures & Cards

Manage email signatures, digital business cards, QR links and campaign banners.

Edition pricing is available on the Velldot workspace site. Module cards describe capabilities and do not list standalone prices.

From signup to work

Your workspace stays yours.

Each organization has its own Velldot workspace and manages its licensed modules through its own Cloud Admin experience.
